title: Multi-Functional Arduino Clock
description: An ESP32-based multifunctional digital clock and countdown timer system featuring a 16×2 I2C LCD display, ambient temperature monitoring via an NTC thermistor, Wi-Fi NTP time synchronization for Sydney/AEST timezone, and two-axis analog joystick navigation.
Highlights: Precision NTP time synchronization over Wi-Fi with automatic Sydney (AEST/AEDT) daylight saving adjustments
Real-time analog temperature telemetry using an NTC 10 kΩ thermistor calculated via the Steinhart–Hart equation
Interactive dual-axis analog joystick navigation featuring stateful page flipping (Off, Clock, Timer) and software debouncing
Configurable countdown timer with 5-minute increment controls, real-time LCD state rendering, and audible piezo buzzer alarms
Low-power standby state with dynamic LCD backlight modulation and non-blocking display buffer updates
